why: docs/reference-fit_results.md section 6.3 (decisions of 2026-10-22). Everything not listed here is as in the fifth fit: solvation EC/DEC 1:1 linear mixing of the MD of the 8 Oct snapshot (COSMO-RS is left for a later fit), network R1-R9+N10-N15, heating episodes of the 2 % tube, error model
energy_box_sigma: every freed reaction energy stays within 3 standard errors (MD) of its computed value; the Gaussian cost of the fifth fit is kept inside the box

structures: one rule for every reaction. Barriers: the first silyl group leaving TMSPA (no P-OH yet) is its own class in hydrolysis (R1, and N15 which follows it) and in transfer (R5); R2-R3 and R6-R7 share one class each. Energies: every independent reaction (R1-R4, R8, R9) has its offset; R5-R7 and N10-N15 follow through the species. Names MX-suffix (X: which energies are free; suffix: how the barriers are grouped): M5-first is the main structure, M3-first (energies of R1-R4) and M3-split (the fifth fit's) are fitted beside it at 1 day and free ages only. Every change from the fifth fit restricts the older structures (water fixed, narrower box), so one that failed there fails here: M3 is not fitted (it failed in the fifth fit, also with the wider prior of the review), and M3-split and M3-first are nested in M5-first, so at 1 h they fail if it fails. M0-BEP, M0-Marcus, M1 and M1-split are kept (minutes) for the ladder

sample_overrides TMSPa alone: no water was added and the literature gives only traces (RXN-01: Karl Fischer about 10 ppm), but the measured reaction is impossible without water. Its water is declared at the least the last spectrum needs (243 h after the first: 0.874 silyl groups gone per phosphorus, 131 mM, at least half a water each: 65.6 mM) instead of fitted. Sensitivity 'water free' fits it as in fits 3-5
scenarios: 1 h, 1 day and free ages (the user's choice; t = 0 or 10 min left out: 1 h already failed in every earlier fit)

effort and start_from: the full search of the fifth fit (8192 screen points, 32 starts) for M3-first and M5-first; a reduced one (4096, 16) for M3-split, which also starts from its own fifth-fit optimum; 2048 points and 8 starts for M5-first at 1 h, the reading that failed in every earlier fit. The fifth fit's parameters, embedded in each structure, are extra starting points only: no box or centre comes from them

night: profiles of the main structure where it fits, and of M3-first at 1 day (does the R5 barrier come out, and does the split move the others); leave-one-out and sensitivities of the main structure where it fits; no indistinguishability block, tolerance check or refits with a trace (all done in the fifth fit); the trace rule is still evaluated on the fits as they are

recovery: two cases of the main structure, free ages (C6) and 1 day (C6-1day), truth close to the fifth fit's answer, two data sets each, with the reduced search (4096, 16): weaker than the fits' own, so a pass is conservative. The second case uses the time saved by leaving M3 and the nested structures at 1 h out

sensitivities: heating as recorded (the only fifth-fit variant that moved chi2 by more than 3), the cost with sigma x0.5 and x2 (the 3 sigma box stays), water free, Peter barriers (N10-N15 all at 1.15 eV: the one exception left to one rule for every reaction), floor x0 and x2 (the fit/no-fit verdict rests on the declared error floor; without it the fifth fit failed)
